Title: Parse Server on Azure managed services

Body.Content: We've released an Azure Marketplace template for easy implementation of Parse Server on Azure. The template integrates Azure App Service, Notification Hubs, Storage, and DocumentDB, with a site extension for the Parse Dashboard. For more details, see the blog post.
